sections: Warranty intro, extended warranty table, footnotes
visualCharacteristics.purpose: genuine tabular data compared row by row (product x coverage x labor)
visualCharacteristics.description: Table with no outer borders and no striping, a 1px rgba(0,0,0,.2) rule under every row. Header first cell 1.25em bold, other header cells 0.9em bold (~14% wide). Body cells padded 1rem 0, top-aligned; a cell may contain a line break. At 480px and below each row stacks: the first cell on its own line (weight 600), then the other two side by side at 75% / 25%.

contentPattern.structure: one row per table row; cells = columns; the first row is the header (rendered as th) unless the no-header option is set
contentPattern.notes: Same authoring as the boilerplate Table block (its decorate is reused). Header cells are plain text, not headings. A line break inside a cell is kept. The mobile stacked layout assumes three columns (label, then two values).

suitableFor: spec or comparison tables with a label column and short value columns
notSuitableFor: tables needing borders or striping (use table with bordered / striped)
